rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for referring to the place or buildings where something happens.

example.traditional: 呢度就係我哋公司嘅地方。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 zau6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 dei6 fong1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the site or area being used for an activity, event, or business.

example.english: This site is not big enough for the event on the premises.
example.traditional: 呢個場地唔夠大，搞唔到個活動。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 coeng4 dei6 m4 gau3 daai6 gaau2 m4 dou3 go3 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this when the premises are being viewed as a property or real-estate holding rather than simply as a place.

example.english: The company recently bought the neighbouring premises.
example.traditional: 公司最近買咗隔籬嗰幅物業。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 maai5 zo2 gaak3 lei4 go2 fuk1 mat6 jip6
